property_summary: For any depositor address that has a positive stored balance, calling withdrawBalance() causes the contract to attempt to send that stored balance to msg.sender; the reference always invokes an external call that forwards the stored balance (and therefore a recording helper will see msg.value == stored balance when the helper is used as msg.sender), whereas the mutant forwards 0 and thus the helper will observe msg.value == 0 for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the temporary amount with zero (send 0) so the external call never forwards funds and thus may succeed or not differently.
